g2-implement.title: Tests + committed end-to-end Spain R reproduction (automatic calibration)
g2-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch a constellation-implementer subagent. TASK: write the test suite under tests/ for src/preprocessing/trajectory/. (1) NESTING ORACLE test: the StintSmoother nests the dense-GP JointFusion (test-oracle) to ~mm on a small synthetic/real span (the lab verified ~0.14mm at-sample, query nodes extend it). (2) SELFTEST: NSStintSmoother with r==1 (lam=0) == StintSmoother to ~1e-10. (3) SYNTHETIC GATE: a known analytic trajectory recovered within tolerance; honest covariance (held-out per-class chi2 ~1) on synthetic data. (4) HONESTY checks: nis_series mean ~1, pos/speed predvar sane, units (dm->m, km/h->m/s). (5) ARTIFACT round-trip: write + read the on-disk artifact, fields preserved. (6) THE COMMITTED END-TO-END REPRODUCTION (tests/integration/): 2022 Spain R, fit the windowless smoother per-driver over each driver's longest green stint using the AUTOMATIC fit_stint_hp calibration for ALL drivers (NO hardcoded KNOWN HP dict — running automatic calibration unattended across the Spain R drivers IS the D3 generalization demonstration), co-estimate real sector loops (b=0), held-out A/B driver split, pooled crossing-time residual; ASSERT pooled held-out median <= 50 ms (lab E10 = 20.21 ms, n=509, p90 59.2 ms, delta 0.06). Mark it slow/integration (it needs the 2022 DB at C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/f1_data_2022.db and the FastF1 cache at C:/Programs/f1Brainz/outputs/cache, absolute paths into the main checkout). Capture the reproduced median/p90/n into an evidence file under .agent-work/issue-448-prod/evidence/. If the automatic calibration does NOT reproduce <=50 ms, STOP and report (do not invent theory or fall back to hardcoded HPs) — that is a float to Admiral. utf-8 child env for captured subprocess output. Wait for and integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT including the reproduced number.
